title: `teploy config get|home|set --json`: an app's config home and, in Teploy home, its config (server-authority spec §2.1-2.3, rev 11)

home.description: Where the app's settings are edited. Consumers must treat an unknown value as "managed elsewhere" (read-only).

commit.description: Config commit the content was read at (get), or the config head (home), or the new commit (set). Absent in folder home and for an empty repository.

applied_commit.description: Config commit of the running release. Absent when nothing runs or the running release was not deployed from Teploy config. commit != applied_commit means the config changed since the last deploy.
